subject.title: feat(workspace): lint and auto-fix code fences in markdown at write time

question: Should OpenClaw add write-time Markdown code-fence linting for workspace files, and if so should it be default auto-fix, opt-in auto-fix, or warn-only?
rationale: This is not a broken existing contract; it mutates user-authored Markdown and adds config surface, and prior implementation attempts were closed after correctness concerns.

options.title: Opt-in or warn-only first
options.body: Implement a parser-backed lint path that does not rewrite existing workspace files by default, then reconsider default auto-fix after real proof.

options.title: Default auto-fix
options.body: Accept the mutation policy and require robust CommonMark parser tests, skip controls, and upgrade/docs proof before implementation.

options.title: Reject core write-time linting
options.body: Leave Markdown formatting to authoring guidance, docs, or plugin/tooling outside the core write path.

recommendation.title: Opt-in or warn-only first
recommendation.body: Implement a parser-backed lint path that does not rewrite existing workspace files by default, then reconsider default auto-fix after real proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest combined signal across recent workspace and markdown-fence parser history.
